preconditions.description: The input must be either a string or an integer.

postconditions.description: The output must be a string.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(input) if isinstance(input, int) else True
postconditions.description: If the input is an integer, the output must be the string representation of the integer.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(['_' + c.lower() if c.isupper() else c for c in input]).lstrip('_') if isinstance(input, str) else True
postconditions.description: If the input is a string, the output must be the string in snake_case notation.
